primitives.name: Charge Hard And Low
primitives.verbatim_quote: INDIVIDUAL POSITIONS 123 posing tackle, and to secure this result there is no better way than to charge hard and low with the shoulder at some point between the hip and knee of the opponent.
primitives.assumptions: Inelastic collision model, constant mass distribution, minimal friction.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Maximum force transfer occurs when the shoulder strikes within the optimal height range (hip to knee), maximizing leverage against the opponent's base of support.

layer2.mapping: GSI - Conformal prediction interval for tackle success probability given strike height.
layer2.telemetry: Tackle success rate vs. strike height percentile.

primitives.name: Ward Off By Hands
primitives.verbatim_quote: The end must go into his man hard, else he will be warded off by the hands of the opposing player, who will then slip between him and his tackle.
primitives.assumptions: Contact mechanics with hand-based resistance, opponent's grip strength as upper bound.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure occurs when hand force exceeds the defender's momentum threshold, leading to separation and gap creation.

layer2.mapping: GSE - Situational reasoning: State transition from 'blocked' to 'gap created'.
layer2.telemetry: Hand contact duration vs. tackle penetration depth.

primitives.name: Aid Tackle Boxing
primitives.verbatim_quote: If the attack is toward his side of the line, the end must aid his tackle in boxing the opposite tackle, in case the point of attack is outside the end position, and in blocking out the opposing tackle when the point of.
primitives.assumptions: Simultaneous multi-body collision avoidance, coordinated lateral movement.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Coordination failure happens when timing mismatches occur, causing overlapping trajectories and reduced effectiveness.

layer2.mapping: GSI - Bayesian network for defensive alignment under pressure.
layer2.telemetry: Boxing efficiency score derived from tackle displacement vectors.

primitives.name: Follow Runner
primitives.verbatim_quote: As soon as the runner has safely passed the opponents' line, the end should follow the man with the ball and make himself useful as the occasion permits.
primitives.assumptions: Constant velocity runner assumption, pursuit angle optimization.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Tracking error increases exponentially if pursuit angle deviates from optimal intercept trajectory.

layer2.mapping: GSE - State-transition model for post-block pursuit behavior.
layer2.telemetry: Distance traveled parallel to scrimmage line per unit time.
